text:
Alicia (AE): Hey team — Kopernik pushed back on the SOW. They insist on BYO-HSM (CloudHSM) + customer key rotation every 90 days, and they also asked for a detailed list of required firewall ports, egress IPs, and a per-op pricing estimate. Can we confirm POC constraints and any enterprise blockers? @Jess (Solutions Eng) @Mike (CryptoEng)

Sam (SRE): For the POC, we'll spin up a small Dedicated pool in us-west1 and run an isolated route to their HSM. Network-wise it's just HTTPS (mTLS) to the HSM endpoint; outbound to hsm.kopernik.example:443. We'll provide three static egress IPs for allowlist. Expect to add 30–70ms latency per remote sign/unwrap.

Jess (Solutions Eng): FYI: with remote HSM, recommend we do a hybrid approach — keep a short-term local KEK cache for signing sessions and only hit the HSM for key unwrap/rotation. That keeps tail latency down. Also need clarification from Kopernik on whether they require key-escrow or a multi-custodian ceremony.

Mike (CryptoEng): Security notes: our BYO flow supports PKCS#11 or vendor-provided TLS API. For onboarding we need: HSM vendor cert chain, a client cert for our connector, and the HSM's public CA. We never persist customer private key material; we do sealed-wrapping via their KEK. Rotation model: 2-phase rollover (generate new KEK, wrap, switch, retire old). If they want split-key escrow, that's an SOW add-on.

Alicia (AE): Kopernik's CISO asked whether we support offline key ceremony windows (their legal wants dual-signatory). Can we run a 4-hour ceremony during cutover? Any operational caveats?

Mike (CryptoEng): We can support scheduled window. Ops will need a canary traffic plan — traffic routed to fallback model while ceremony runs, then cutover to rewrapped KEK. We'll document the rollback plan. Also ask Kopernik to provide the HSM operator contact and maintenance SLA.

Sam (SRE): Firewall/Networking checklist I'll send to them. Minimal: outbound 443 to provided fqdn(s). For the POC testing we will give them a curl example:

```
curl -v --cert client.pem --key client.key \
  -H 'Host: hsm.kopernik.example' \
  https://hsm.kopernik.example/api/v1/handshake
```

Also note: we need their CIDR for IP allowlist and an expected qps so we can size the Dedicated pool.

Jess (Solutions Eng): Pricing/rate conversation: BYO-HSM adds a fixed connector setup fee (one-time) + an ops surcharge for outbound egress and HSM ops routing. Ballpark for POC (low qps): connector setup $3k, monthly ops surcharge $1.2k, plus per-kms-op metered at our standard KMS rate. If they want key ceremony support + split-escrow add-on, that changes the SOW.

Alicia (AE): Copying Kopernik's CISO thread so they see the ask. They also want our answers to the security questionnaire before next Tuesday.

SecurityBot: Security questionnaire answers ready: link: https://redwood.internal/ssq/2265432199-kopernik. Key points prefilled: we support CMK (customer-managed keys), do not export private key material, rotation supported, HSM onboarding requires vendor certs and mTLS. See section 4.2 for the rotation playbook. :lock: :white_check_mark:

Mike (CryptoEng): One blocker: if their HSM enforces per-origin firewall rules (source IP restrictions) AND they want dynamic autoscaling on our side, we need either a NAT pool they will allow or a connector hosted in their VPC. If they require private linkage, that's Private deployment (extra engineering lead time).

Alicia (AE): Kopernik prefers not to open to public IPs. They asked whether we can do a connector in their VPC for POC. What's the ETA and cost delta?

Sam (SRE): We can do a temporary VPC connector in ~2 weeks (security review + infra), estimated eng effort 3-4 days plus infra. Cost delta: add-on of $X/month and a one-time setup fee. I'll scope exact numbers and post in this thread by EOD.

Jess (Solutions Eng): Action items: 1) Sam to post exact egress IPs and VPC connector estimate; 2) Mike to attach HSM onboarding checklist and rotation playbook; 3) Alicia to push sec questionnaire link to Kopernik and request vendor cert chain + CIDR + qps.

Alicia (AE): Thanks — I'll sync with Kopernik and get back with vendor cert chain and CIDR today. :thumbsup:

Sam (SRE): Posting egress IPs and initial cost sheet now (see pinned doc).

Mike (CryptoEng): Uploading HSM onboarding checklist to the thread (internal link).

Alicia (AE): Great — closing this loop. We'll aim to have the signed MoM and questionnaire responses by Monday.
